title: Sheehan gets access to every internal Scientology file

tellings.quote: I said that look I wouldn't even meet with Ron hubard unless there was a condition precedent that I could be given access to every single document anywhere in the world uh in internal files of the Church of Scientology

plain: In the 1970s the lawyer Dan Sheehan says he refused to meet L. Ron Hubbard, founder of the Church of Scientology, unless he was first given access to "every single document anywhere in the world" in the church's internal files, including those of its Guardian's Office, an internal department. He tells Michels the condition was met at the church's headquarters in Florida, and he names Hubbard's wife Mary Sue Hubbard as part of the story. If true, an outside lawyer saw the whole of one of the most secretive organisations in America from the inside.
